nextStoryContext: US-R8-001 fixed the exact non-hermeticity the reviewer found: test/integration/dashboard-pane-selfspawn.test.ts pinned a fixed tmux socket name (TEST_SOCK = 'cam-it-selfspawn'), and its beforeEach/afterEach both ran `tmux kill-server` against that shared socket. Any second process running this same test file concurrently (a real scenario: the worker quality gate's `bun test`, `cam next` preflight, and the reviewer's own independent re-runs can all overlap) would destroy the FIRST instance's tmux server mid-test, killing the respawned pane child before it could write marker.json, so the waitForCondition at the end reliably timed out at exactly 10s in that collision window. Fix (1 file, mechanical, exactly as the story specified): `const TEST_SOCK = \`cam-it-selfspawn-${process.pid}\`;` -- deriving the socket name from process.pid instead of a fixed literal makes every concurrent test process bind to a numerically distinct tmux socket, so `kill-server` can never reach another instance's server (tmux's `-L` flag creates fully independent per-name servers; verified against the OpenBSD tmux(1) man page in Step 5.5 below -- this is not an inference, it's the documented mechanism). Verified empirically, not just by inspection: ran the test file twice at once (`bun test ... & bun test ... & wait`), both copies passed cleanly, reproducing exactly the two-simultaneous-copies scenario the reviewer's evidence table showed failing 2/6 times before the fix. Also ran the single-file test alone (1 pass) and the full suite (`bun test`: 5935 pass / 0 fail, same count as before -- no test added, one pre-existing test's socket-name derivation changed) and the full `bun run check:all` spine (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all green). No file-size or coverage budget edits were needed (the diff is +6/-1 lines, a comment plus the one-line socket derivation). The story's own text explicitly scoped the other 15 pre-existing integration files sharing the fixed-socket convention as OUT of scope for this finding -- do not touch them here; if a future reviewer finding calls out a SPECIFIC other file by the same mechanism, fix that file the same way (per-process-derived socket name), but do not proactively sweep all 15 as part of an unrelated story. scripts/cam/prd.json also picked up two sibling round-8 review findings (US-R8-002: fd-leak fix has no falsifying test in src/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.ts; US-R8-003: patterns.md states the isSidecarArgv contract twice with one dangling cross-reference) already present in prd.json before this story started (committed as part of this story's commit since they were already staged in the working tree at session start) -- both remain passes:false and are candidates for the next dispatch.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed the -L flag creates fully independent per-socket-name tmux servers ('several independent tmux servers'), so deriving TEST_SOCK from process.pid guarantees kill-server can never cross two concurrently-running test processes -- this is the documented mechanism behind the fix, not an assumption.
